description: Sophena provides a planning application for local heating networks. GreenDelta publishes its source repository, which describes an Eclipse RCP desktop application and a companion data-packaging utility. Build instructions identify Java, Maven and Eclipse requirements. The provider is GreenDelta. Coverage: Coverage follows the network or reservoir supplied by the user. Spatial detail and the simulated time horizon are model settings; there is no fixed observation period. Access: Source code and build documentation are publicly accessible on GitHub. No source archive or binary was downloaded. Licence and cost: The repository states that the source code is under Mozilla Public License 2.0 unless otherwise stated. Public source access is free; building it still requires the documented development tools. Limitations: The README describes Windows builds. Installation, packaged-data quality and performance on other systems were not tested. For simulation preparation it supports local heating-network planning and comparison of project configurations. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes covers pipe-network calculations. This is a thematic relation, not a claim of software interoperability.
